pairs: Admonish them to be subordinate to the rulers
ad omne opus bonum paratos esse:
to be prepared for every good work,
to speak evil of no one,
omnem ostendentes mansuetudinem ad omnes homines.
displaying all meekness toward all men.
Eramus enim aliquando et nos insipientes,
servants of various desires and pleasures,
being hateful and hating one another.
Cum autem benignitas et humanitas apparuit Salvatoris nostri Dei,
But then the kindness and humanity of God our Savior appeared.
non ex operibus justitiæ, quæ fecimus nos, sed secundum suam misericordiam salvos nos fecit per lavacrum regenerationis et renovationis Spiritus Sancti,
And he saved us, not by works of justice that we had done, but, in accord with his mercy, by the washing of regeneration and by the renovation of the Holy Spirit,
quem effudit in nos abunde per Jesum Christum Salvatorem nostrum:
whom he has poured out upon us in abundance, through Jesus Christ our Savior,
so that, having been justified by his grace,
hæredes simus secundum spem vitæ æternæ.
we may become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
et de his volo te confirmare:
And I want you to confirm these things,
ut curent bonis operibus præesse qui credunt Deo.
so that those who believe in God may take care to excel in good works.
as well as arguments against the law.
Avoid a man who is a heretic,
after the first and second correction,
sciens quia subversus est, qui ejusmodi est,
knowing that one who is like this has been subverted,
for he has been condemned by his own judgment.
hurry to return to me at Nicopolis.
For I have decided to winter there.
Zenam legisperitum et Apollo sollicite præmitte,
Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollo ahead with care,
and let nothing be lacking to them.
Discant autem et nostri bonis operibus præesse ad usus necessarios:
But let our men also learn to excel in good works pertaining to the necessities of life,
so that they may not be unfruitful.
Salutant te qui mecum sunt omnes:
All those who are with me greet you.
saluta eos qui nos amant in fide.
Greet those who love us in the faith.
May the grace of God be with you all.
